description: This file defines features and workarounds for Direct3D (D3D) driver bugs and issues within the ANGLE project. It includes structures for compiler workarounds and a class for D3D features with various workaround flags.

classes.name: CompilerWorkaroundsD3D
classes.description: Struct holding boolean flags for D3D shader workarounds such as optimization skipping and IEEE strictness.

classes.name: FeaturesD3D
classes.description: Class representing a set of D3D features and workarounds, inheriting from FeatureSetBase, with multiple specific workaround features.
